newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Kabila's Congo shuts 60 schools in quality drive.
newsitem.headline: Kabila's Congo shuts 60 schools in quality drive.

text.p: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has closed about 60 private elementary and high schools in the capital Kinshasa in a crackdown on low standards, state radio said on Monday.
It said the three-month-old government of President Laurent Kabila would soon extend the drive to the interior of the vast Central African country.
Private schools mushroomed in the former Zaire because of the virtual collapse of the state education system under dictator Mobutu Sese Seko, who was toppled by Kabila in May.
Schools are on summer vacation until next month.
